title: Together Link: frontier-quality open models in the harness you already use
authors: Will Van Eaton, Hassan El Mghari
gist: A one-command setup that points an existing coding agent (Claude Code, Codex and others) at open models hosted by Together. In auto mode a router reads the first task of each session and picks a model once. With the user's own Anthropic key it chooses between a closed frontier model and an open one; without it, between a strong open model and a fast one.
changes: Open and frontier models sharing one harness, with the choice made by the serving side. Routing once per session is a design forced by the layer below: switching mid-session would throw away the prompt cache.
caveats: No quality, latency or price benchmarks. The over-50% saving is against an all-frontier counterfactual with no method given. A session that gets harder stays on the model it started with.

bears_on.note: A shipped product that splits sessions between an open model and a frontier one inside the same harness.
How often the model can be chosen is set by the prompt cache, a property of the traffic, not of the router.
